prompt: I have washed 5 shirts and put them all out to dry at the same time. They all took 5 hours. If I wash 30 shirts and put them all out to dry at the same time, how long will they take to dry?
response: If you wash 30 shirts and put them all out to dry at the same time, they will take longer to dry because there are more shirts. It might take around 10 hours for all of them to dry completely.
